race.comment: PIZZA PRINCE (4) made a nice return at his latest appearance a week ago, finishing a nose away in second at this circuit and distance. Has won two of three second-up attempts so should be fitter. Can build on the strong start to the campaign. INSTANT DELIGHT NZ (1) made it six minor placings from her past eight starts when she finished third last time out. Likely to get the favours from this nice draw. Player again. SECOND TO NUN (3) was held up for a run at a vital stage when fifth last start. Won from a 50m handicap prior. Worth another chance. MOREEP (2) draws well and must be respected after scoring last week by 4.5 metres, giving her three wins and a second from her last three attempts at this circuit and distance.
